functionalRequirement: User will choose from options including searching for their issue, chatting with customer support, asking the community, emailing customer support, or calling customer support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must clearly display all available support options (e.g., search, chat, community, email, call) with concise descriptions for 100% of user interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to select from various support options, necessitating clear and recognizable choices.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for users to navigate through support options, with a maximum of 2 clicks to reach any support option from the initial page.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with multiple support options, requiring an easy-to-learn interface.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must display all support options within 500 milliseconds of the user accessing the support page.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to support options, requiring timely responses for usability.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to grant edit permissions for assets to departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, and university users based on their department affiliation and authorization level.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must grant edit permissions to all specified user roles (departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, university users) based on their department affiliation and authorization level for 100% of valid scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to manage permissions for various user roles, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authorization: The system must enforce edit permissions based on user roles and department affiliation, with a maximum of 1% false positives or false negatives in access control decisions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves managing sensitive permissions, requiring robust access control mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from permission-related errors (e.g., incorrect role assignment) within 1 minute, with no data loss or corruption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to assets, necessitating fault-tolerant permission management.

functionalRequirement: Texts sent to that number will be sent to the API, then the system will reply to the user with the answer as another text message.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must respond to user texts with an answer within 2 seconds of receiving the text, for up to 100 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time text-based interactions, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to receive and respond to texts for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to text-based support, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt text messages using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves exchanging potentially sensitive information via text messages, requiring protection.

functionalRequirement: After adding a transportation route, the user shall be able to retrieve transportation requests from other users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately retrieve transportation requests from other users after a transportation route is added, with a maximum of 1% errors in request retrieval.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to manage transportation requests, necessitating correct and accurate retrieval.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for users to add transportation routes and retrieve requests, with consistent parameter naming (e.g., route ID, request ID) across all endpoints.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with transportation routes and requests, requiring easy-to-operate interfaces.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to process transportation route additions and request retrievals for a single user interaction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple transportation routes and requests.

functionalRequirement: The Disputes System shall allow users to create charge back requests, prompting for required information and resulting in printed notifications sent to merchants if proof of disputed transactions is not provided.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must prompt users for all required information (e.g., transaction ID, dispute reason) when creating charge back requests, for 100% of valid scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to manage charge back requests, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must prevent users from submitting incomplete or invalid charge back requests, with clear error messages and prompts for correction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with sensitive financial information, requiring robust error protection mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure the integrity of charge back requests and associated data (e.g., transaction IDs, dispute reasons), with tamper-evident auditing and logging mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves managing sensitive financial information, requiring robust integrity mechanisms.
